rules: Same fixed financial target, two candidate histories, independent pilot and audits, full common-calendar covariance
Half total error for four observable financial bands, half for two equal-tail binomial audit intervals; no data-selected error split
Registered pilot uses three draws per case with distinct pilot_seed; no final outcomes used to alter procedures
All 400 draws retained in each case; singular truth is used only to evaluate coverage, not supplied to estimation
Regular delta availability and coverage among all requests and among available requests are separate
Projection reports coverage, probability of bounded output, disconnected output, whole real line, and width conditional on bounded output
No finite plotting grid truncates effect sets; no mapping-sign constraint is assumed
Audit correctness and independent representative sampling are assumptions; biased calibration is outside the coverage guarantee

Before final draws, sum/difference reparameterization selected from the mixing equations; the wider candidate-coordinate pilot and code are archived, and both confidence constructions remain in final comparison.

projection.scope: Projection of simultaneous normal/HAC observable bands and exact binomial audit intervals; finite-sample audit coverage, asymptotic response coverage; no lower bound on linkage rank
